# Recommendation Requirements Quality Checklist: Personalized Related Plans Ordering

**Purpose**: Validate that the related-plans requirements are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and testable before implementation. Focus areas: ranking behaviour and identity/privacy lifecycle.
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are ordering requirements defined for every catalogue surface (main, company, search)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all three signal kinds explicitly enumerated with their relative strength? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all profile lifecycle states (anonymous, account, merged, cleared) enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a profile whose recorded preference was produced against an older plan space? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for unpublishing or retiring a plan that already has recorded interest? [Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for ranking when no published plans match the active filters? [Completeness, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Are retention requirements specified for both interest profiles and recorded signals? [Completeness, Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Are "strongest", "moderate", and "weakest" signal strengths quantified with concrete weights or a strict ordering constraint? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "diminishing influence" defined precisely enough to be objectively verified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the bound on cumulative influence stated as a measurable value rather than a qualitative promise? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "one combined influence" for a multi-result search defined as a specific aggregation rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "unchanged order" defined with an explicit comparison rule across reloads and sessions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the cold-start prior described precisely enough that two independent viewers necessarily receive the same order? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the per-minute signal cap quantified with a specific number? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the default-sort requirements agree across User Story 1, FR-001, and the search exclusion in FR-015/FR-021? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the sign-in merge rules consistent with the sign-out clearing rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the success criteria for order movement agree with the stated signal-strength ordering? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Are identity semantics identical for ranking and for signal submission? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "the device follows the account" unambiguously reconciled with "device interest is cleared on sign-out"? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are alternate flows defined for a visitor who signs in without any prior anonymous history? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK021 Are exception flows defined for a signal that arrives during or immediately after sign-in? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are recovery requirements defined when a signal cannot be delivered? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for shared-device use by more than one anonymous person? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for automated traffic that lacks a stable device identity? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements explicit that only the first page of a submitted search contributes an impression? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for signals that reference plans which no longer exist or are no longer published? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 Are privacy requirements explicit that anonymous identity is opaque and not derived from personal data or fingerprinting? [Completeness, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the inactivity period after which a profile expires quantified? [Clarity, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined that prevent interest history from being displayed to the viewer or shared with another account? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK030 Are performance requirements specified for ranking the entire filtered catalogue rather than the visible page? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK031 Are degradation requirements defined when the recommendation path is slow or unavailable? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK032 Are observability requirements defined for ranking, signal recording, and merge events? [Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK033 Can "that type ranks higher on the next catalog load" be measured without a defined baseline? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK034 Is "identical order" in SC-003 and SC-009 measurable across sessions and independent devices? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK035 Is "no interest is attributed to two identities" objectively verifiable from the requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Is the dependency on the existing device-identity mechanism documented and validated? [Dependency, Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that a lost signal "never breaks the order" reconciled with the persistence requirements? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the assumption that profile state is authoritative across devices documented? [Assumption]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK039 Is it clear whether the company catalogue defaults to the related order or merely offers it? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK040 Is "related plans" an appropriate label for an intent-based order, and is the intended user-facing wording fixed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK041 Is it specified whether an explicit sort choice persists across visits or resets to related? [Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
